raw_response: In the first iteration, all six candidates met the constraints, with energy costs well below the maximum allowed (1.4) and stability scores above the minimum required (0.75). The best candidate, iter1_cand1, achieved the lowest energy cost of 0.30873 while maintaining a high stability score of 0.96147. Other candidates showed slightly higher energy costs but comparable stability and performance. No constraint violations were observed, and no failure reasons were identified, indicating that the initial design space was well-explored and valid.
